summary: Links may go only to the repo's public pages or to the page itself. Six links that escape must each fail the check; two that are fine must pass.

issues.title: Check that links go only to this repo's public pages
issues.body:
Every link on the page goes to this repo's public pages on GitHub (`github.com/todd450/founding-agents-site`: its code, issues and PRs) or to a place on this page. Nothing points at the private plugin repo, which answers 404 to the nightly link check and opens a `red` issue, or anywhere else. Add a check for it, run from `check.sh`.

Holds for every site issue: every claim on the page is true on the day this merges, using the facts in `docs/status.md`; it reads at 390 px and at 1440 px.

## Files
`tests/`, `check.sh`

## Technical decisions
None: a check inside the existing checks.
